module: 'TCS Debug' window of the live Vehicle Editor: plots in real time (600 history points) the traction control data of the vehicle's first 'esc' type controller (debugData.tcs): braking factors per wheel, slip per wheel with threshold, throttle factors and overall slip. Three PlotMultiLines graphs.
notes: If the vehicle has no esc controller, vEditor.tcsData is nil and nothing is plotted.
The histories are initialized only once (didInit) with the keys seen at the first reception; a vehicle change does not reinitialize them.
At most 4 wheel colors (5 for graph 2) are defined; beyond that, the color is nil.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame: requests the TCS data from the vehicle, updates the histories and draws the graphs.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called when the extension is loaded: fills the slipThresholds history with 600 zeros.
